q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is 2026-08-15. Q2 FY2027 for NVIDIA would typically end in July 2026, with earnings released shortly thereafter (likely late August 2026 based on the pattern shown). The actual earnings release has likely already occurred or is imminent—we are essentially at the resolution point. Time left: essentially zero (days/weeks, not months).

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The research provided states that **NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, released on May 20, 2026, predicts approximately $91.0 billion** (±2%).

This is the actual guidance figure that NVIDIA provided to the market. Since we are now in mid-August 2026 and Q2 FY2027 would have concluded in July 2026, the earnings release with actual results and forward guidance for Q3 would be imminent or just released.

The question asks for "forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release"—this is asking for the guidance NVIDIA gives when reporting Q2 results, which according to the research was approximately $91.0 billion for Q3 FY2027 (the next quarter's guidance, issued during the Q2 earnings call/release).

The most likely outcome is **$91.0 billion** because this is the explicit guidance figure already disclosed by NVIDIA on May 20, 2026.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Deteriorating demand signals in the interim
- Weakness in AI infrastructure spending beyond China restrictions
- Supply chain constraints emerging
- Macroeconomic headwinds not yet reflected in May guidance
- Competitive pressures intensifying
- Margin pressure forcing lower revenue guidance

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Better-than-expected demand for H100/H200 GPUs
- Data center capex accelerating beyond expectations
- New customer wins or expanded deployments
- Weakening of geopolitical restrictions
- Market share gains from competitors
- Higher ASPs (average selling prices) if premium products gain share

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- **Q1 FY2027 actual revenue: $81.6 billion** (85% YoY growth)
- **Q2 FY2027 forward guidance: $91.0 billion** (±2%, released May 20, 2026)
- **Wall Street analyst consensus for Q2 FY2027: ~$91.8 billion** (range $90.3B–$96.7B)
- **LSEG analysts' prior average estimate: $86.84 billion** (which the $91B guidance exceeded)

The guidance of $91.0 billion ±2% gives a range of $89.18B to $92.82B with the midpoint at $91.0B.

---

## Reasoning on Distribution

Since the actual guidance figure of $91.0 billion (±2%) has already been publicly released by NVIDIA, the central estimate should be anchored directly on this disclosed figure. The ±2% margin of error suggests NVIDIA is comfortable with a range of $89.18B to $92.82B.

Given:
- The explicit nature of the disclosed guidance
- The narrow ±2% margin of error NVIDIA provided
- The fact that this is now historical (released May 20, 2026, and we're in August 2026)
- Wall Street consensus slightly higher at $91.8B but within the guidance range

The distribution should be tightly centered around $91.0 billion, with limited tail risk since this is official company guidance that has already been provided.

Low (10th percentile): 89200000000000
Median (50th percentile): 91000000000000
High (90th percentile): 92800000000000
q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, released on May 20, 2026, predicts approximately $91.0 billion, with a margin of error of plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This outlook explicitly excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/).

This guidance surpasses the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion by LSEG analysts [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/). For context, NVIDIA reported record revenue of $81.6 billion in Q1 FY2027, an 85% increase year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [barchart.com](https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3449043/what-to-expect-from-nvidia-s-q2-2027-earnings-report). Wall Street analysts currently anticipate Q2 FY2027 revenue to be around $91.8 billion, with estimates ranging from $90.3 billion to $96.7 billion [tickerleague.com](https://tickerleague.com/companies/NVDA/estimates).
